name: Calling in the Reserves
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
narrative.objectives: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. Now I can spend some time with my family... Yippee!
narrative.requestItemsText: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
